10089|0e051c59.name: Silvaria
10089|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

1070|8a3dd721.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|8a3dd721.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lass, then mark me--you've found it!

10897|c5ceacbe.name: Sindrayl
10897|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

11068|fe5ba491.name: Betty Quin
11068|fe5ba491.text: Hmm... well you seem capable enough. If you truly desire to learn, then nothing will stand in your way! I will guide you through your first steps on what I hope will be a long and fulfilling path.

11800|2051e10a.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|2051e10a.text: Would you like a flight to Rut'theran Village, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

1275|ed056522.name: Kyra Boucher
1275|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1292|aebd25b1.name: Maris Granger
1292|aebd25b1.text: Do I look like I have the time or energy to coddle every tourist that wanders through my door? Tell me what you need, and make it quick.

1314|0624ab70.name: Duncan Cullen
1314|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1317|f472d1d3.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|f472d1d3.text: A true professional know his limitations, and I'm not ashamed to admit that your skills exceed mine. I want you to pay a visit to Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora. She is well-renowned, and with good reason.

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

1346|29243a62.name: Georgio Bolero
1346|29243a62.text: You'll need more training before I can share my knowledge with you, I'm afraid.

2456|6928abbf.name: Newton Burnside
2456|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

342|076b3629.name: Martie Jainrose
342|076b3629.text: Hail, WILLA!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3702|5ae56d71.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
3702|5ae56d71.text: Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

4146|08830bac.name: Jocaste
4146|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

415|26f5a1f4.name: Verner Osgood
415|26f5a1f4.text: Hey ma'am, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

4217|34f0a84a.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
4217|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5498|9c6df40b.name: Elsharin
5498|9c6df40b.text: Greetings $c.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

6301|7a1efc7f.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|7a1efc7f.text: Greetings lad, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

119-complete.name: Verner Osgood
119-complete.text:
Thank you, this really helps me out.

But what's this?  Argus sent a note with the crate...What??  Argus wants me to PAY him?  Bah!

Well, $N, thank you for your help.
119-complete.title: Return to Verner

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

121-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-complete.text:
Thank you for your time, $c.  For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.

Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery.  Something is amiss in our Kingdom.  I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
121-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-accept.name: Verner Osgood
122-accept.text:
I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire.  If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.

Black dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander.  You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.
122-accept.title: Underbelly Scales

122-complete.name: Verner Osgood
122-complete.text: Thanks!  These will get me out of debt to Argus...
122-complete.title: Underbelly Scales

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

124-accept.name: Verner Osgood
124-accept.text:
As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...

If you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
124-accept.title: A Baying of Gnolls

130-complete.name: Martie Jainrose
130-complete.text:
You need a bouquet of flowers?  You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?

I know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... especially in dangerous times like these.
130-complete.title: Visit the Herbalist

131-accept.name: Martie Jainrose
131-accept.text: Here is your bouquet.  I chose Daffodils for you.  They're my favorite!
131-accept.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-complete.name: Darcy
131-complete.text:
Oh, those are lovely!  I can't wait to put them in some water!

But...these are Martie's favorite flowers.  Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he?  You didn't tell her who they were for, did you?  If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.

Oh, but it's not your fault.  Thank you, and here's your meal.
131-complete.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

132-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-complete.text: Bah!  I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance.  But this information is crucial.  Good work.
132-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
135-accept.text: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons.  Perhaps that was a slip of tongue.  Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons?  Only one man would know for sure:  Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
135-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-complete.text: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
135-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
141-accept.text:
The Stonemasons' Guild was run by a man named Edwin VanCleef.  VanCleef was responsible for rebuilding Stormwind after the orcs razed it in the First War.  Apparently, VanCleef and his men were unhappy with their treatment by the King after the reconstruction was complete.  That just might explain a thing or two.

I have written a more detailed account for your Master in Westfall.  Take this to him at once!
141-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

143-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
143-accept.text:
Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.

Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
143-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-complete.text: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
143-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
144-accept.text:
Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.

Take this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
144-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

180-accept.name: Unknown
180-accept.text:
Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore

Known leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth.  By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead.  Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.
180-accept.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

2178-complete.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-complete.text: Fantastic! Try it and tell me what you think, $N!
2178-complete.title: Easy Strider Living

2178-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-progress.text: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
2178-progress.title: Easy Strider Living

246-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
246-complete.text:
<Deputy Feldon listens to your report...>

There's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones.  It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.

Here you are, $N.  We are grateful for your aid.

And if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate Solomon within Lakeshire.  Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
246-complete.title: Assessing the Threat

34-accept.name: Martie Jainrose
34-accept.text:
Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged.  And I know the brute who is doing it.  It's that forsaken boar, the one Marshal Marris has taken to calling Bellygrub.

I won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now.  Ruined!  All ruined by that one menacing boar.  Put an end to that pest!  Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you.  He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.
34-accept.title: An Unwelcome Guest

34-progress.name: Martie Jainrose
34-progress.text: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
34-progress.title: An Unwelcome Guest

3524-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-progress.text: It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers.  I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort.  Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
3524-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
4681-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4723-accept.name: Unknown
4723-accept.text:
The remains of a giant thresher - much larger than one you'd expect to find in Darkshore - lie beached on the coast of the Mist's Edge.  How this creature came to be here is unknown; the group of murlocs that now feast off the carcass of it seem to be much too weak, even in large numbers, to have brought down the beast. 

While some of it has been picked clean, enough of it remains to take a sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine to study.
4723-accept.title: Beached Sea Creature

4723-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-complete.text: Another discovery - well done $N!  These remains will be properly studied once they get to Darnassus.  Please accept this small honorarium in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.
4723-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4723-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-progress.text:
Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore.  Until then, we must continue our research!

Greetings $N - what news do you bring?
4723-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

91-accept.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-accept.text:
An enemy of Stormwind has taken up residence in the eastern foothills of Redridge. This wicked villain uses the Arcane to spread terror and misery upon our town and our people. Under the name, Morganth, he conducts his evil business.

Morganth now controls the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan to perform his biddings. As stated by the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the Kingdom is punishable by death.

These vile gnolls must be killed!

Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-accept.title: Solomon's Law

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

954-complete.name: Asterion
954-complete.text:
Ahh... To what could I possibly owe the exceedingly special honor of a $r such as yourself as company. Truly it says much of my current companions--with no offense to my hosts, the noble grells and satyrs--that your presence could be considered an improvement.

But please, do not let my uncivil tongue drive you from the place. It has indeed been many years, decades even, since I had civil accompaniment.
954-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

955-accept.name: Asterion
955-accept.text:
If I were to relate the story of my life, I have no doubt it would surpass the limits of your patience. Let us say that mine has been a long and painful life, and this spectral form is perhaps the worst torment of all.

I am held here by the means of magic. Though my words may seem disingenuous, I assure you I would be grateful beyond words if you would help me find the means of my imprisonment. A seal binds me, and by examining the earpieces of the sprites and grells, I may find a trace of it.
955-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

983-progress.name: Unknown
983-progress.text: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
983-progress.title: Buzzbox 827

98393-accept.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
98393-accept.text:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young $c. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
98393-accept.title: The Great Cat Spirit

98404-complete.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-complete.text:
Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.

I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young $c.
98404-complete.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98404-progress.name: Avatar of Saeyleenan
98404-progress.text: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
98404-progress.title: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force
